brave._note: Ceiling on Brave Search calls per curator run (403 fallbacks + topic queries). The key is shared with curated-podcast-generator, whose research budget is the same monthly cap. Late-October nights use 0-3 calls; this only stops a night of mass 403s. feed_discovery.py has its own weekly list (BRAVE_SEARCH_TOPICS).

topic_queries._note: Off since 2026-09-23; kept off after the trial, reviewed 2026-10-11. The 45 queries in topic_queries.json cost ~47 Brave calls a night on a Search key the podcast shares, and on 2026-09-23 had supplied 1 of 467 category-feed items and 15 of 569 podcast-feed items. Across the trial, weekly noise-to-signal held at 2.28-2.39 and Brave fell to ~10 calls a week. Set true to restore. Feed-recovery searches for failing feeds are unaffected.

hot_refresh._note: refresh-hot.yml, every 2 h between nightlies: plain GETs, quality gate only, no cache commits. min_score sits in the gate's top band (60-79 held ~5% of a night's articles in October 2026). Off: set enabled false. kite_batch_max_age_hours: Kagi News cuts one batch a day at 12:00 UTC; only a run within this many hours of it reads the batch (the 12:41 run, once), so its news clusters land that afternoon instead of 18 h later with the nightly. Remove the key to stop.

standing_preferences._note: Feeds that ignore the reader's [show] lines in config/standing_preferences.txt. Those lines keep a subject off the podcast and out of every other feed; news keeps it, so the reader still sees the world (added 2026-11-07, docs/decisions/scoring.md). Remove news to make the lines apply everywhere again.

kagi_news._note: Kagi News clusters: one story per event, already merged across outlets and summarised, so each enters as the finished version of its story (wins same-story dedup over any non-local outlet; never sent to Kagi Extract; its summary + talking points become the podcast's story body). Free. category_map sets a provisional feed category from Kite's label; deep scoring can still move it. Agriculture is unmapped on purpose: homestead is hobby-scale, and commodity-market stories belong to the podcast's Working Lands day, not a feed. Broadened 2026-11-07 from 11 to 27 categories, 12 stories each (Kite publishes about 12): regions, economy and diplomacy into news, plus topic categories for the interest feeds. Each is one free GET; the extra clusters cost only gate tokens. digest: one item a day at the top of the news feed listing the news-mapped clusters with at least min_sources outlets that reached no feed (gate junk excluded). headline_min_sources: a cluster this widely covered counts as a headline in run_stats.kite_coverage, which the weekly audit reads as the headline miss rate.
